name: adopted_bridge_preservation_floor
motivation: A naive current-query exact-hit floor rescued one historical-fix-adjacent record but retained 116 additional non-fix records. This refinement requires evidence that an identifier is both selected from prior trajectory state by frozen V3 and explicitly reused by the agent in its current retrieval query.
algorithm: parse conservative structured identifiers from the current rg/grep search pattern
read the frozen V3 trajectory bridge identifiers for the same captured search exposure
an identifier is adopted only when the current query identifier exactly equals a frozen V3 bridge identifier case-insensitively
preserve baseline-dropped search records containing an exact identifier-boundary match for an adopted bridge
all other records retain the existing current-query-only baseline decision
primary_metrics: fix-adjacent fraction among newly kept records
limits: post-hoc exploratory because the preservation failure was already observed
historical-fix-adjacent is a proxy, not causal ground truth
